entries.entry: Received SWPC K-index warning WARK07 (serial 214) by email and the reliability coordinator call.
Reviewed operating procedure TOP-GMD-01; condition of Kp 7 forecast is met.
Called Harbor Generation Station and Northfield Electric Cooperative.
Planned outage on Harbor 345 kV corridor deferred.
Neutral current alarm at Harbor substation transformer T2; engineer called.
Reliability coordinator reports Kp 6 observed. Procedure remains in effect.

fields.footer: Exercise log. Not a compliance record.
